description:
Get the full reported history of a single XBRL financial concept for one company.
Faster and smaller than sec_company_financials when you only need one metric's time series (e.g. quarterly revenue for 10 years).

Common concepts: Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity, EarningsPerShareBasic, CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue.
name: sec_company_concept
